summary: The diff implements comprehensive error handling and debugging features to fix product display issues. It adds an ErrorBoundary component, wraps key routes with error boundaries, enhances logging throughout the product fetching pipeline, adds defensive validation in ProductCard and useQueries, and implements fallback error UI in ProductsPage. All four requirements appear to be addressed with extensive console logging, error handling, and product data validation.

hallucinated_features.description: Image URL mapping logic in ProductsPage that transforms backend image URLs to local generated asset paths
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly states 'Do not change the backend schema or product data structure' as a constraint, and non-goals include 'Adding new features beyond fixing the current error'. The productsWithLocalImages logic that maps product names to local image paths (e.g., 'Turmeric Powder' → '/assets/generated/turmeric-powder.dim_400x400.png') is a new feature transformation not requested in any requirement.
